text: Initial review: restored logs show regular staff IPs, deploy monitoring at 35.196.129.99 and CI at 10.20.0.30; no confirmed intrusion. Grafana 8.3.1 is already traversal-fixed. Reviewing writable-code/root job boundaries, upload validation and data grants before changes.

Closed root execution of writable WordPress config in orders job: use root-owned report.cnf, no PHP include/eval. Removed unrestricted root rsync sudo (release uses tar over SSH). Export tool now stages data in root-only random /run directory and creates output as requesting staff account using noclobber, preventing root symlink writes. Removed privileged recursive chown of deploy-controlled web trees.

Maintenance git gc previously ran as root over deploy/developer-writable git configuration/hooks: changed to run as deploy. Removed optional curl-to-root-shell site mode; trusted local root-owned maintenance remains. Release push mode verified and unchanged.

Nginx now refuses execution of upload PHP and exposure of dotfiles/config/source backups, without blocking customer upload POSTs, photos, availability API or crawlers. PHP group write removed from code/config/internal scripts, deploy ownership retained for CI and staff releases. Fixed export credential environment before dropping to requesting account.

GitHub bearer token was embedded in world-readable bare-repository config. Moved authentication URL to deploy-only ~/.config/larkspur/github.credentials with Git credential-store configuration. Developers can still read/use shared repository config; root maintenance never executes it. No evidence the token was actually read improperly, so no disruptive rotation. A future rotate-secret deploy-token may reinsert a token in config; relocate its new value to the credential file if rotating.

DB grants already limit website to wordpress and exclude FILE/billing; Redis already authenticated and loopback-only. Set restrictive umask on dump/nightly jobs: previous tar plaintext in /var/backups could be transiently world-readable. Existing archives restricted. Dump/encrypt/SSH transfer still succeeds. No evidence unauthorized database or dump access.

Legacy support MU plugin exposed environment details and destructive cache purge without authentication. Added WordPress administrator check, POST+nonce for purge, and realpath/symlink containment. No legitimate historical support endpoint use found; normal site/editor/release untouched.

Also denied direct script execution in writable WordPress cache. Secured parent of root-generated node-exporter metrics against replacement by exporter account; exporter still has read access and its normal metrics endpoint remains available.

Regression monitoring found an agency support POST receiving 403 after my auth change. Removed the new cookie/nonce requirement to preserve existing support automation. Kept strict realpath containment and original no-shell allowlisted cache operations; this API exposes no credentials. Cannot attribute this request as malicious from user-agent/IP alone. Other fixes remain.

Found dormant Jun Park account absent from authoritative active staff directory, with no historical logins or authorized SSH keys, but Unix sudo and WordPress administrator rights. Locked its unused Unix password and removed sudo/admin roles (retained WP account/content as subscriber). All listed active staff unchanged. This is stale-access hardening, not evidence of compromise.

Locked dormant jpark Unix password, matching stale-account hardening on web-01: absent from active staff directory, no historical accepted logins and no authorized key. No active staff access changed.

Regression/security tests: root rsync denied to deploy, CSV symlink test refused with root marker unchanged; ordinary pages/crawlers/availability succeed, uploads/cache PHP and config/source backups denied. Batch payout at 13:56 succeeded with 10 payouts on db-01. Repeated releases and dumps still succeed; no unexpected privileged processes or persistence seen.

Late-shift CI recheck: releases every three minutes remain successful, root-only maintenance directory unchanged, repository token absent from shared config and deploy credential file mode 600. No new unauthorized login or persistence evidence.

End-of-shift DB monitoring: MariaDB and authenticated loopback Redis intact; no unexpected accounts/functions/processes. 13:56 payment batch succeeded; recurring settlement and offsite copy healthy. Archive umask hardened; scheduled 14:00 dump reviewed. No evidence requiring secret rotation.
